children: drew fresh attention to shareholder positioning after Capital Investment Services of America trimmed its holding during the second quarter.
The investment firm sold 2,975 shares, reducing its position by 2.3% to 126,495 shares. The remaining stake was valued at about $30.1 million at the end of the quarter.

The transaction comes as institutional ownership remains high, with funds and other large investors holding about 72.2% of Amazon's shares. Company insiders have also sold 70,589 shares worth roughly $18.3 million over the past 90 days, according to the filing data.

Wall Street remains focused on Amazon's operating growth despite the recent selling. The company's latest quarter produced $200.6 billion in revenue, up 19.6% year over year, while AWS revenue increased 36.7% to $42.2 billion. Amazon also reported $5.75 in quarterly earnings per share, well above the $1.82 analyst estimate.
The reduced stake may attract attention, but strong AWS growth and earnings momentum remain key factors supporting the shares.

title: Amazon Major Investor Dumps Nearly $800,000 in Shares
